title: The Bakerian Lecture: On the Manufacture of Glass for Optical Purposes
version: Original 1830 Philosophical Transactions paper, read November–December 1829; reprinted in Experimental Researches in Chemistry and Physics (1859), pp. 231–290. Internet Archive OCR of the public-domain volume.
lineage: Contemporary participant account, accessed in author’s later collected reprint. The 1858 editorial footnote is distinguished from the original 1829 lecture text.

passages.quote: A room and furnaces were built at the Royal Institution in September 1827
passages.note: Read the committee, earlier Falcon site, RI move, assistant and September 1828 specialization passages; quoted location and date verified in OCR.
Read reasons for changing glass composition, platinum-vessel use and the described preparation; not a claim to have read the whole 60-page paper.
